title: Reporting Dimension
description: Standard breakdown vocabulary that reporting subscriptions select by, stable across sellers (experimental, media_buy.reporting_subscriptions). Sellers map each report definition's native dimensions onto these values. Receivers MUST accept unknown values; a selector naming a value the seller does not map matches no offering.

enumDescriptions.package: One row per media-buy package. A contract_version 1.2 report definition names this breakdown with its package_id dimension.
enumDescriptions.metro: One row per metro area in one metro system, such as Nielsen DMAs. dimension_systems.metro names the system.
enumDescriptions.postal_area: One row per postal area in one country's postal system, such as US ZIP codes. dimension_systems.postal_area names the country and system.
